scene.title: 游戏厅 / Arcade play
scene.act_title: 第一幕：进入游戏厅 / Act 1: Entering the arcade

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 儿童视角中景 / child-height medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 三个孩子刚进入游戏厅内部，两个弟弟停住脚步，被烟雾、CRT屏幕光和混杂人群震住；哥哥故作镇定，侧身示意他们跟紧。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Three Chinese schoolboys just inside the doorway; two younger boys frozen by smoke, CRT light and crowded silhouettes, older brother pretending to be mature and signaling them to follow, child-height perspective, blue-green light on faces.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 承接第一幕进入室内，强调两个弟弟的震慑和哥哥的装成熟。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 手部特写 / insert close-up
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 哥哥从口袋里掏出一张皱旧的一元人民币，纸币被手汗和年代痕迹压皱，背景是模糊的柜台和老板。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Insert close-up of an older brother child hand pulling out a worn 1990s Chinese one-yuan banknote, wrinkled paper texture, sweaty fingers, blurred arcade counter and owner in background, authentic period detail.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 钱必须真实、年代感强；避免可读文字过清导致模型乱字，可强调纸币质感和颜色。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 道具特写 / prop insert
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 老板把三个粗糙的金属游戏币放到哥哥掌心，硬币边缘磨损，反射着绿色街机光。两个弟弟在虚焦里盯着。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Close-up of three rough worn metal arcade tokens dropping into a schoolboy palm, chipped edges, green CRT reflections, younger brothers blurred in background watching eagerly, authentic 1990s Chinese arcade tokens.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 游戏币是核心年代道具，要粗糙、廉价、被摸旧。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 跟拍中景 / tracking medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 哥哥握着游戏币，驾轻就熟地穿过人群走向一台真人快打街机；两个弟弟紧跟在后面，眼睛被屏幕吸住。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Tracking medium shot of older brother confidently leading two younger boys through crowded smoky arcade toward a Mortal Kombat-style old fighting game cabinet, tokens in hand, younger boys staring at screens, no readable logos.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 街机可暗示真人快打，不要出现清晰商标文字。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 街机侧面近景 / side close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 游戏币投入投币口，哥哥双手落在摇杆和按钮上，动作熟练；两个弟弟站在旁边，脸上是崇拜和紧张。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Side close shot of a token entering an old arcade coin slot, older brother hands confidently on joystick and buttons, two younger brothers beside him watching with admiration and tension, CRT fighting game glow.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 投币口、手、按钮、弟弟表情要一起服务哥哥“熟练”的形象。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 中近景 / medium close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 屏幕光照在哥哥脸上，他压着得意继续操作；两个弟弟在旁边兴奋地小声欢呼，周围开始有人回头。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Medium close shot of older brother lit by CRT glow, focused and slightly smug while playing a fighting game, two younger brothers cheering quietly beside him, nearby teenagers turning their heads, smoky arcade background.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 情绪从震慑转为短暂胜利，哥哥不能过分夸张。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 广角压迫镜头 / crowded wide shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 街机周围的人越围越多，肩膀和后脑勺形成压迫感。三个孩子被挤在机器前，哥哥仍然站在中心。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Crowded wide shot around an old fighting game cabinet, shoulders and backs forming pressure around three schoolboys, older brother centered at controls, smoky low ceiling, plastic stools, mixed teenagers and adults but no modern clothing.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 围观是危险升温，不只是热闹。

nearby_storyboard_cards.beat: 黄毛插入副机位投币挑战
nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 双人机位中景 / two-player medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 一个和哥哥年纪相仿的黄毛小痞子突然挤到副操作位，不说话直接投币。哥哥侧头愣了一下，两个弟弟也安静下来。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Medium shot of a same-age teenage yellow-haired local punk boy pushing into the second player position and dropping a token without speaking, older brother surprised but composed, younger brothers suddenly quiet, old dual-control arcade cabinet.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 黄毛必须是初中生小痞子，不是成年人；挑战动作要干脆。

nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 强调哥哥的轻蔑和熟练，但仍保持孩子气。

nearby_storyboard_cards.beat: 黄毛骂骂咧咧再次投币
nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 快速剪辑特写组 / montage inserts
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 黄毛不服气，嘴里骂着又掏游戏币。画面切到投币口、狰狞表情、按键手指和弟弟紧张的眼神。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Rapid montage-style storyboard panel: yellow-haired teen punk angry and cursing, another token pushed into coin slot, grimacing face, aggressive fingers smashing arcade buttons, younger brothers watching nervously, gritty smoky arcade.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 这条可以作为快剪提示；不要生成文字脏话。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 低角度近景 / low close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 连续失败后，黄毛用拳头砸了一下按钮台，塑料按钮和金属面板震动。哥哥和弟弟都短暂僵住。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Low close shot of yellow-haired teen punk slamming his fist onto an old arcade control panel after repeated losses, buttons shaking, older brother and younger boys frozen in background, tension under CRT glow.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 这是危险第一次显形，控制力度，不要变成打斗。

nearby_storyboard_cards.beat: 黄毛离开前恶狠狠盯哥哥
nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 凝视中近景 / tense medium close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 黄毛转身离开前停了一下，恶狠狠地盯了哥哥一眼，没有说话。哥哥表面得意，两个弟弟的笑意收住。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 儿童视角中景 / child-height medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 三个孩子刚进入游戏厅内部，两个弟弟停住脚步，被烟雾、CRT屏幕光和混杂人群震住；哥哥故作镇定，侧身示意他们跟紧。

Three Chinese schoolboys just inside the doorway; two younger boys frozen by smoke, CRT light and crowded silhouettes, older brother pretending to be mature and signaling them to follow, child-height perspective, blue-green light on faces.

Insert close-up of an older brother child hand pulling out a worn 1990s Chinese one-yuan banknote, wrinkled paper texture, sweaty fingers, blurred arcade counter and owner in background, authentic period detail.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 钱必须真实、年代感强；避免可读文字过清导致模型乱字，可强调纸币质感和颜色。

Close-up of three rough worn metal arcade tokens dropping into a schoolboy palm, chipped edges, green CRT reflections, younger brothers blurred in background watching eagerly, authentic 1990s Chinese arcade tokens.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 游戏币是核心年代道具，要粗糙、廉价、被摸旧。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 跟拍中景 / tracking medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 哥哥握着游戏币，驾轻就熟地穿过人群走向一台真人快打街机；两个弟弟紧跟在后面，眼睛被屏幕吸住。

Tracking medium shot of older brother confidently leading two younger boys through crowded smoky arcade toward a Mortal Kombat-style old fighting game cabinet, tokens in hand, younger boys staring at screens, no readable logos.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 街机可暗示真人快打，不要出现清晰商标文字。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 街机侧面近景 / side close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 游戏币投入投币口，哥哥双手落在摇杆和按钮上，动作熟练；两个弟弟站在旁边，脸上是崇拜和紧张。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Side close shot of a token entering an old arcade coin slot, older brother hands confidently on joystick and buttons, two younger brothers beside him watching with admiration and tension, CRT fighting game glow.

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 中近景 / medium close shot

nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 情绪从震慑转为短暂胜利，哥哥不能过分夸张。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 双人机位中景 / two-player medium shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 一个和哥哥年纪相仿的黄毛小痞子突然挤到副操作位，不说话直接投币。哥哥侧头愣了一下，两个弟弟也安静下来。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Medium shot of a same-age teenage yellow-haired local punk boy pushing into the second player position and dropping a token without speaking, older brother surprised but composed, younger brothers suddenly quiet, old dual-control arcade cabinet.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 黄毛必须是初中生小痞子，不是成年人；挑战动作要干脆。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 过肩对抗镜头 / over-the-shoulder duel shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 从黄毛肩后看哥哥操作，哥哥嘴角轻微一笑后快速按键，屏幕光把两人的脸分成冷暖两侧。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Over-the-shoulder duel shot from behind the yellow-haired teen punk, older brother at opposite controls with a restrained smirk, fast hands on buttons, CRT light splitting their faces, tense arcade crowd around them.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 强调哥哥的轻蔑和熟练，但仍保持孩子气。

nearby_storyboard_cards.beat: 黄毛骂骂咧咧再次投币
nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 快速剪辑特写组 / montage inserts
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 黄毛不服气，嘴里骂着又掏游戏币。画面切到投币口、狰狞表情、按键手指和弟弟紧张的眼神。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Rapid montage-style storyboard panel: yellow-haired teen punk angry and cursing, another token pushed into coin slot, grimacing face, aggressive fingers smashing arcade buttons, younger brothers watching nervously, gritty smoky arcade.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 这条可以作为快剪提示；不要生成文字脏话。

nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 低角度近景 / low close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 连续失败后，黄毛用拳头砸了一下按钮台，塑料按钮和金属面板震动。哥哥和弟弟都短暂僵住。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Low close shot of yellow-haired teen punk slamming his fist onto an old arcade control panel after repeated losses, buttons shaking, older brother and younger boys frozen in background, tension under CRT glow.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 这是危险第一次显形，控制力度，不要变成打斗。

nearby_storyboard_cards.beat: 黄毛离开前恶狠狠盯哥哥
nearby_storyboard_cards.shot_type: 凝视中近景 / tense medium close shot
nearby_storyboard_cards.frame_description: 黄毛转身离开前停了一下，恶狠狠地盯了哥哥一眼，没有说话。哥哥表面得意，两个弟弟的笑意收住。
nearby_storyboard_cards.image_prompt: Cinematic storyboard keyframe, 1990s northern Chinese small-town underground arcade, gritty social realism, smoky air, old CRT arcade cabinet glow, worn school backpacks, realistic film still, clean composition, no modern smartphone, no modern esports hall, no cyberpunk, no readable random text, no watermark. Tense medium close shot of same-age yellow-haired punk turning away but stopping to glare silently at the older brother, older brother trying to look proud, younger brothers’ smiles fading, smoky arcade crowd blurred behind, ominous but realistic.
nearby_storyboard_cards.notes: 第二幕收束在无声威胁，给后续冲突埋钩子。
